what: sheet.path_flange along a two-line path across the y = 0 edge of a 100 x 60 x 2 base: 20 up, then 10 out away from the base (a Z section)
method: T = 2, R = 2, K = 0.5, setback R + T = 4 at each 90 degree bend.
